components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Moves the user forward in a task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:46px; padding:0 18px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:#4edea3; color:#003924; font:800 14px/1 DM Sans, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#63efb5; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #91f4cc; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.96); }

components.name: Nutrition Input
components.description: A labeled field for a measured food value.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:#bbcabf; font:800 12px/1.3 DM Sans,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:48px; border:1px solid #3c4a42; border-radius:10px; padding:0 12px; background:#272f2a; color:#e1e3df; font:700 16px DM Sans,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#4edea3; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(78 222 163 / 14%); outline:0; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Current location in the daily application shell.
components.css: .ds-nav-current { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:46px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; background:rgb(78 222 163 / 14%); color:#4edea3; font:800 14px DM Sans,sans-serif; } .ds-nav-current svg { width:20px; height:20px; fill:currentColor; } .ds-nav-current:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #91f4cc; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Working Panel
components.description: A bounded group of daily work without excess visual elevation.
components.css: .ds-panel { display:grid; gap:8px; padding:20px; border:1px solid rgb(60 74 66 / 55%); border-radius:14px; background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(22 29 25 / 96%),rgb(14 21 17 / 96%)); color:#e1e3df; box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgb(0 0 0 / 36%); font:700 15px DM Sans,sans-serif; } .ds-panel span { color:#bbcabf; font-size:13px; }

components.name: Public Entry Link
components.description: The landing action that takes an existing account holder to sign in.
components.css: .ds-entry { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:50px; padding:0 19px; border-radius:12px; background:#4edea3; color:#003924; font:850 14px DM Sans,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background 160ms ease; } .ds-entry:hover { background:#63efb5; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-entry:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #91f4cc; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: ScaleGrams is a calm instrument for a moment that repeats several times a day. Its dark field belongs to the phone-at-the-table scene: light enough to read in a kitchen or after training, quiet enough that a logged meal never feels like a verdict. The interface gives measurements a physical place, then makes the next action obvious.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, low-glare surfaces with mint reserved for forward motion and completion.
Dense but breathable daily records with tabular figures and explicit states.
Rounded, tactile controls sized for touch without turning every element into a card.
Calm motion that confirms a state change instead of competing with the data.

rules.name: Signal Budget Rule
rules.body: Mint is for a decision, a current position or a completed step. A screen may contain many measurements, but only one forward action should read as mint-first.

rules.name: Measurement Rule
rules.body: Nutritional values use tabular figures when alignment matters; a number should read as data before it reads as decoration.

rules.name: Calm Surface Rule
rules.body: Do not stack a prominent border, bright glow and heavy shadow on the same resting container. Depth has one job at a time.

dos: Do use semantic tokens from the foundation before introducing a new color, radius, shadow or timing value.
Do make the current task and its next action visible within a single viewport on mobile.
Do use mint for active, selected, completed or forward-moving states.
Do keep public product claims limited to functions that exist in the application.
donts: Don't use color as the only indicator of validation, completion or selection.
Don't turn every informational group into an equally styled card.
Don't use bright mint as decorative background coverage or body copy.
Don't offer public registration while ScaleGrams remains account-access only.
